title: Unit Event — Happy Enjoy Music! — Episode7 Where Music Resounds

meta.Event Outline: With their new song released, Leo/need looks forward to Jam Fest. Saki, nervous before her first festival, encounters a familiar face...

rows.Line: Music Cafe

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wow...
It's so lively in here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, also... I think someone's singing while playing the piano.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like they've already gotten started.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I'm guessing it's one of the regulars.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (This song... Mom's loved it for like ever.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Talk about a blast from the past...
I ended up memorizing it because she always sings it while cooking and stuff.)

rows.Speaker: Regulars
rows.Line: Great performance!

rows.Speaker: Regulars
rows.Line: Thanks! Who wants to play next?

rows.Speaker: Regulars
rows.Line:
Oh, mind if I go?
There's a song I'd like to play.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Oh, now it's someone else's turn.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, this is a Miku song!

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: That's incredible. You immediately recognized the intro?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. Ichi loves Miku just that much!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah, that is pretty incredible...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But this song is still fairly new.
I wasn't expecting to hear it here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That might mean she loves Miku just as much as you do, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Y-You think so?
I'd love to ask her...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Hehe. Something tells me that you'll fit right in here, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: After all, this place is a friendly forum for music.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, Ichika, I think you're gonna really like this place.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, this cafe is really nice...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Older songs, more recent songs...
It's clear that this place brings the generations together musically.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: I'm not all that interested in any music outside what I normally listen to...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: But, I guess as long as everyone's having fun.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There you go again.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line:
Hehe...
We really love the atmosphere here.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Plus, when everyone sings and plays together, it really hits you just how much they all love music.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Yeah.
That's why we wanted to introduce you all to this cafe.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm loving this place already!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Iori, Mio, thank you for introducing us to this wonderful cafe.

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line: Huh? Hey, Iori, I didn't realize you two were here!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Oh, hello.
Another fun-filled evening, I see.

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line: Yup! We gotta party it up since we're here!

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line: Oh, are you Iori's friends?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... Y-Yes...!

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line:
Haha. Try to relax.
I'm a customer like you!

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line: Since you're here, why don't you play something! I bet you'll really enjoy it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, play something?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You mean, on the piano?

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line: Yeah, it should be free soon.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wh-What should we do...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
What do you say, Tenma?
You play the keyboard, so wanna give it a go?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, me?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
You did used to play the piano a lot, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If anything, you have more experience playing the piano than the keyboard.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
True...
It's probably been quite a while, but why don't you give it a try?

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line:
Hey, really?!
Then, play a song for us!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: B-But I'm really not that good...!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Don't be shy.
Playing in a place like this can be a really positive experience.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line:
She's right.
No one here cares about how good or bad someone is.

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line: As long as you possess a love for music, then you'll do just fine!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A love for music...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki...!

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Then, I'll let you know when it's your turn. Sit tight until then.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I wasn't expecting to be asked to play the piano during our after-party...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(I'm a little nervous...
But if I'm going to play, I should try to have fun...!)
